findings.evidence: Both `key` blocks open with `rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, Subgroup.coe_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ...]` and then finish with `apply_symm_apply`/`symm_apply_apply` rewrites. No existing helper covers this: grep in ./code/TauCeti for `coe_mul_symm|mul_symm_apply` finds nothing relevant.
findings.fix: Add one reusable `@[simp]` lemma next to `localTranslate` in Stabilizer.lean, e.g. `coe_mul_symm_apply (k₁ k₂ : orthogonalGroup Q) x : ((k₁ * k₂ : _) : M ≃ₗ M).symm x = (k₂ : M ≃ₗ M).symm ((k₁ : M ≃ₗ M).symm x)`. Use it in both proofs (instantiated with k₁ = g_p⁻¹ in the first) instead of the inline `key` blocks.
findings.issue: The local `key` in `adelicTranslate_eq_adelicTranslate_iff` and the one in `adelicTranslate_finiteAdelicOrthogonalDiagonal_mul_carrier` prove the same fact: the inverse of a product in the orthogonal group, applied to x, is (k₁ * k₂)⁻¹ x = k₂⁻¹ (k₁⁻¹ x). Each does it with the same brittle chain `LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq, Subgroup.coe_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp, ...`, and each spells out the ascription `(_ : ℚ_[p] ⊗[ℚ] V ≃ₗ[ℚ_[p]] ℚ_[p] ⊗[ℚ] V)` many times.

findings.evidence: `let q : Nat.Primes := ⟨p, Fact.out⟩`, then `⟨g q, L.orthogonalGroup_norm_baseChange p ▸ (g q).2⟩`, then `dsimp only [q] at hq`.
findings.fix: State a `(p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]` version of `padicLocalization_adelicTranslate_carrier`, or make the proof pass through an explicit lemma relating `q` and `p`. At minimum, add a comment explaining why the coercion unfolding is needed.
findings.issue: `sameGenus_adelicTranslate` works with `p : ℕ` but uses the `Nat.Primes` value `q := ⟨p, _⟩`. It feeds `g q` where an element of `orthogonalGroup (L.norm.baseChange ℚ_[p])` is expected, and repairs `hq` with `dsimp only [q] at hq`. Both depend on `((⟨p,_⟩ : Nat.Primes) : ℕ)` reducing to `p` by definitional unfolding, and nothing documents this.

summary: Two proofs each re-derive the same step, (g*h)⁻¹ x = h⁻¹(g⁻¹ x) for elements of the orthogonal group, as a local `key` built from a five-step rewrite chain, and `sameGenus_adelicTranslate` depends on an undocumented definitional unfolding of the `Nat.Primes` coercion.
